name: unequal lengths, noncontiguous tensors and padding mask
input: unequal lengths, noncontiguous tensors and padding mask
test:
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import scaled_dot_product_attention
torch.manual_seed(446)
q = torch.randn(2, 3, 5, 4, dtype=torch.double).transpose(-2, -1)
k = torch.randn(2, 3, 5, 6, dtype=torch.double).transpose(-2, -1)
v = torch.randn(2, 3, 7, 6, dtype=torch.double).transpose(-2, -1)
mask = torch.tensor([[[[True, False, True, False, True, False]]], [[[False, True, False, True, False, True]]]])
snapshots = [t.clone() for t in (q, k, v, mask)]
out = masked_qkv_attention(q, k, v, mask)
assert out.shape == (2, 3, 4, 7)
assert out.dtype == q.dtype and out.device == q.device
torch.testing.assert_close(out, scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=mask))
for tensor, snapshot in zip((q, k, v, mask), snapshots):
    assert torch.equal(tensor, snapshot)
print('ok')

name: unmasked, causal and combined causal-padding attention
input: unmasked, causal and combined causal-padding attention
test:
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import scaled_dot_product_attention
torch.manual_seed(446)
q = torch.randn(2, 2, 4, 3)
k = torch.randn(2, 2, 4, 3)
v = torch.randn(2, 2, 4, 5)
causal = torch.ones(4, 4, dtype=torch.bool).tril()
padding = torch.tensor([[[[True, True, True, False]]], [[[True, True, False, False]]]])
for mask in (None, causal, causal & padding):
    out = masked_qkv_attention(q, k, v, mask)
    assert out.dtype == q.dtype and out.device == q.device
    torch.testing.assert_close(out, scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=mask))
print('ok')

name: gradients through all three inputs
test:
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import scaled_dot_product_attention
torch.manual_seed(446)
q = torch.randn(1, 2, 3, 4, dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
k = torch.randn(1, 2, 5, 4, dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
v = torch.randn(1, 2, 5, 2, dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, True, False]])
out = masked_qkv_attention(q, k, v, mask)
expected = scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=mask)
got_grads = torch.autograd.grad(out.square().sum(), (q, k, v))
expected_grads = torch.autograd.grad(expected.square().sum(), (q, k, v))
for got, expected_grad in zip(got_grads, expected_grads):
    assert torch.isfinite(got).all()
    torch.testing.assert_close(got, expected_grad)
print('ok')

name: large scores use stable softmax and singleton keys return their value
input: large scores use stable softmax and singleton keys return their value
test:
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import scaled_dot_product_attention
torch.manual_seed(446)
q = torch.tensor([[[[10000., -10000.]]]])
k = torch.tensor([[[[10000., -10000.], [-10000., 10000.]]]])
v = torch.tensor([[[[2., 3.], [7., 11.]]]])
out = masked_qkv_attention(q, k, v)
assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
torch.testing.assert_close(out, scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v))
one = masked_qkv_attention(q, k[..., :1, :], v[..., :1, :])
torch.testing.assert_close(one, v[..., :1, :])
print('ok')

name: mixed precision avoids score overflow and preserves gradients
test:
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import scaled_dot_product_attention
for dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
    q = torch.tensor([[[[10000., -10000.]]]], dtype=dtype)
    k = torch.tensor([[[[10000., -10000.], [-10000., 10000.]]]], dtype=dtype)
    v = torch.tensor([[[[2., 3.], [7., 11.]]]], dtype=dtype)
    out = masked_qkv_attention(q, k, v)
    expected = scaled_dot_product_attention(q.float(), k.float(), v.float()).to(dtype)
    assert out.dtype == dtype and torch.isfinite(out).all()
    torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected)
    torch.manual_seed(446)
    inputs = [torch.randn(1, 1, 2, 3, dtype=dtype, requires_grad=True) for _ in range(3)]
    out = masked_qkv_attention(*inputs)
    grads = torch.autograd.grad(out.float().square().sum(), inputs)
    assert all(torch.isfinite(g).all() and g.abs().sum() > 0 for g in grads)
print('ok')
